upload_diff_to_codereview: upload diffs from git, mercurial, or subversion to the codereview.appspot.com server for code review
generate_diff_with_vcs: generate a diff against a specific revision using git, mercurial, or subversion version control
encode_multipart_form_data: encode form fields and files into multipart/form-data format for HTTP POST requests
authenticate_with_clientlogin: authenticate with Google ClientLogin API to obtain auth tokens and cookies for the review server
run_shell_command: execute a shell command and capture stdout output and return code from subprocess
